    • OrderLine

      public OrderLine(MenuItem item, List<Customization> customizations, int quantity)
      Creates a cart line.
      Parameters:
      item - the drink being ordered
      customizations - the chosen customizations (copied, so later changes to the list are ignored)
      quantity - how many of this drink
